versions.description_html:
That growth number in your Power BI report doesn't exist yet. Power BI won't show you sales versus last year until someone writes the calculation behind it, and that calculation is where most beginners stop.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why the Number You Want Is Hard to Get
  • What a Measure Really Is, and Why Templates Weren't Enough
  • What Quick Measure Suggestions Actually Does
  • What Happens When You Actually Ask for a Measure
  • Where It Actually Shines
  • Where It Gets Things Wrong Without Warning
  • The Costs and Limits Nobody Mentions First
  • How to Use It Without Getting Burned

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
